summary: WorksheetGroups implement grouping, searching, updating, and reporting of worksheet entries tied to academic, site, instructor, and service contexts in HSPnet. They support bulk operations, grouping rules, calendar and scheduling logic, call for offers, capacity management, and integration with print/report jobs.
purpose: To enable efficient management, grouping, searching, updating, scheduling, and reporting of worksheet entries (for placements, courses, sites, instructors, etc.) particularly in bulk or group contexts. Designed for workflow automation and tracking within academic placement systems.

workflows.name: GroupWorksheetSearch
steps: Set up search parameters (groupFlag, IDs, filters, use blocks, etc.)
Invoke stored procedure 'GroupWorksheetSearch'
Iterate through results and construct WorksheetGroup entries
Format dates and status codes
Calculate and accumulate statistics, including rotations and blocks
Handle capacity and over-capacity warnings
Return list and stats

workflows.name: GroupWorksheetAccepted
steps: Set up parameters (groupFlag, rollup, worksheetID, filters, etc.)
Invoke stored procedure 'GroupWorksheetAccepted'
Iterate through results, construct WorksheetGroup entries
Return accepted counts, group/block info

workflows.name: GroupWorksheetAdd/Update
steps: Prepare parameters for add/update (including all fields)
Invoke 'GroupWorksheetAdd' or 'GroupWorksheetUpdate' as needed
Update DB with new values, including block2, rotation, preceptors, etc.
Handle template and request code requirements

workflows.name: SendToDestination (Reporting/Printing)
steps: Prepare PRs and WorksheetGroups
For each entry, create report/placement print jobs as needed
Handle print job status, deletion, and warnings
Support individual PDFs and report queueing

workflows.name: Copy/Change Date
steps: For selected entries, copy previous term data or update date
Handle bulk/batch operations
Delete or warn as required

business_rules: If siteID, governingOrgID, instructorID, or serviceID is 0, use 'ALL' for display
If campusID == 0 and zeroIsAllCampuses, show as 'ALL'; else as 'No Campus'
CFO (Call For Offers) entries are managed with group and parent/child logic
Statuses and formatting depend on PRStatus, block number, and other flags
Days and times are formatted for scheduling display including shift/amendment icons
validations: Day fields (Monday-Sunday) and VariousDays must be logically consistent
Date/time blocks must be valid and formatted
MaxSpaces must not be exceeded unless flagged
Request codes may be required for certain entries
Supervisor/instructor presence validated for site instructor logic
calculations: Accepted counts per group/block, including offer remaining logic for CFO
Column totals: RequestTotal, CreatedTotal, AcceptedTotal, plus rotation/block equivalents
conditions: If groupFlag is true, grouping and block2 logic applies
CFOParent determined by UseCallForOffers and CFOWorksheetGroupID
Date filters and status code lists control results
DraftFilter returns only entries without PR
system_behavior: Integration with print/report jobs (including deletion, update, queueing)
Error/warning handling for database and print job operations
Formatting for calendar grid, scheduling icons, and site instructor/preceptor presentation
dependencies: Resources for labels, statuses, error/warning messages
exceptions: No entries for selected group/term: warning message
SQLError during print jobs: error message
Over-capacity flagged visually and/or in warning
Deleted entries with PR exist: not deleted, warning
content_gaps: No mapping of all possible status codes or workflow transitions.
No information about user interface actions or error recovery beyond message display.
No details on API endpoints or integration with external systems.
No sample data or user stories.
